label: Claude's 3 of 12 start rate is 3 of 4 read-only run rows and 0 of 8 mutating start rows; opencode and dsh adopt 3 of 8 mutating rows, so one aggregate rate describes opposite behaviour.
The start rate measures the path, not the outcome: devin produced the create-agent artifacts in three runtimes while scoring started false, and 5 of 8 mutating devin rows wrote.
The ask policy stops at the command: devin created a council scratch folder and pi wrote a retrieval fixture on ask rows without asking, because the skill path carries no policy.
No before-arm start is attributable to the advisor: the brief names no command and COMMAND: narration is 0 of 24 on four runtimes and 1 of 12 on dsh.
